results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.description: Job Summary: The role will lead and manage P&L, operations, and business growth for trucking fleets and lead teams, win new business, improve network safety, and ensure high on-time delivery rates across the GCC network Key Responsibilities Commercial Accountability Grow revenue and gross margin for the road freight division. Build pricing models and bid strategies for new customer contracts. Secure new business and keep key client accounts happy. Work with sales teams to pitch integrated 3PL solutions. Operations Accountability Oversee daily truckload (TL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) transport performance. Track metrics like on-time delivery, cost per mile, and asset utilization. Manage carrier relationships, partner networks, and subcontractor rates. Drive continuous improvement in transit times and route planning. Team Leadership Lead operations managers, dispatchers, and sales account leads. Set clear performance goals and run regular team reviews. Hire, train, and mentor staff to build a strong workplace culture. Ensure all drivers and staff follow health, safety, and labor laws. Skills: Strong budget management, contract negotiation, and data analysis. Knowledge: Deep understanding of road freight markets, Hours of Service (HOS) rules, and TMS technology.

results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 25+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. We are seeking an exceptional Senior Manager to lead Fleet Strategy, Planning and Programs for the MEATR (Africa, Middle East, and Turkey) region—one of our fastest-growing and most dynamic markets. In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic architect of MEATRs fleet operations, responsible for the complete fleet lifecycle from demand forecasting and procurement to operational excellence and partner experience. You'll leverage sophisticated analytical modeling to predict fleet requirements years in advance, drive operational excellence through data-driven insights, and ensure our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) have the tools and support they need to succeed. results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Manager, Micro Mobility Operations
results.description: Redefining Land, Air, and Sea Travel… Elevating Destinations. Coastal Transportation Services Co., a Red Sea Global Subsidiary Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides Transportation services at our Red Sea destination and is part of the Red Sea Global Group of companies. We specialize in providing transportation services to our Red Sea destination. As a subsidiary, Coastal Transportation Services Co. benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group of companies, enhancing our ability to serve our clients effectively. Are you ready to transform the future of transportation? At Coastal Transportation Services Co., we are driven by innovation, creativity, and a passion for redefining transportation. Our team is shaping the future with cutting-edge projects, from autonomous vehicles to sustainable transportation solutions. We are seeking forward-thinking individuals eager to collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where ideas become reality. Join us in revolutionizing transportation and creating a smarter, more sustainable world—one innovation at a time. Join our visionary team and help shape the future of transportation! Job Purpose: To lead the operational planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of micro mobility services across the organization’s properties. This role is responsible for ensuring seamless delivery of buggy, e-bike, and other micro mobility solutions, supporting the wider Mobility strategy. The position holds accountability for service delivery, stakeholder engagement, team leadership and operational efficiency in a 24/7 environment. Key Responsibilities: Service Operations Leadership Manage daily micro mobility operations across multiple service types and locations. Ensure service continuity, timely asset availability and operational resilience. Support integration of new modes (e.g., e-bikes, scooters) as part of service expansion. Team and Resource Management Lead supervisory staff, operators, and support teams across the micro mobility network. Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned with safety and customer service. Oversee training, onboarding, and staff scheduling to meet service requirements. Performance and Compliance Oversight Ensure all services operate within regulatory, safety and policy frameworks. Monitor service metrics and deliver improvement plans to enhance efficiency and user satisfaction. Implement incident management protocols and ensure timely resolution of issues. Stakeholder Engagement Act as key point of contact for operational queries, escalations, and service coordination. Work cross-functionally with departments including Land Operations, TOCC, Maintenance and Projects. Liaise with vendors and partners to support service delivery and infrastructure readiness. Planning and Development Support service expansion through structured operational plans and asset deployment strategies. Drive forward innovation and technology adoption within micro mobility operations. Assist in the development of SOPs, risk assessments and operational documentation. Reporting and Communication Provide regular operational updates, service performance reports and improvement proposals. Ensure consistent communication across teams and with leadership. Profile Requirements Experience in operations or transport leadership, preferably within micro mobility or fleet services. Proven ability to manage teams in fast-paced, high-visibility environments. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and resolve challenges quickly. Operational mindset with the ability to lead services at both strategic and frontline levels. Adaptable and resourceful, with a commitment to service excellence.

results.title: Senior Director – Autonomous Mobility
results.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Director – Autonomous Mobility to lead the establishment, commercialization, and scaling of a new autonomous mobility business in the region. This is a high-impact business leadership role with end-to-end accountability for strategy, P&L, commercialization, regulatory engagement, strategic partnerships, operations, and organizational development. Qualifications MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Logistics, Technology, Mobility, or a related discipline. 10–15 years of relevant experience in mobility, logistics, CEP, autonomous vehicles, smart mobility, or adjacent technology-enabled sectors. Significant experience in the UAE or GCC is strongly preferred. Proven track record of launching, scaling, and commercializing new businesses, products, or technology-enabled services. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong commercial track record. Experience working in startup, venture-building, transformation, or high-growth environments. Strong experience engaging with government and regulatory stakeholders. Experience with public-private partnerships or government-led innovation programs is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of the mobility and CEP sectors, including smart cities, urban logistics, last-mile delivery economics, and operating models. Practical understanding of autonomous vehicle technologies, deployment models, safety requirements, and operational considerations. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the business strategy for autonomous mobility, aligned with the organization’s growth and innovation agenda. Develop scalable commercial models for autonomous mobility solutions across public roads, campuses, private developments, and other relevant environments. Own the business P&L, including revenue growth, cost management, investment planning, and overall financial performance. Lead go-to-market strategy, pricing, customer acquisition, commercial pipeline development, and strategic partnerships. Develop and execute autonomous vehicle deployment programs from business case and pilot through to commercial scale. Lead engagement with UAE regulatory and government authorities to secure approvals and enable compliant operations. Establish strong governance across safety, regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, data privacy, operational performance, and risk management. Build strategic partnerships with CEP operators, e-commerce platforms, retailers, government entities, real estate developers, technology providers, and other ecosystem stakeholders. Identify opportunities to expand into adjacent autonomous technologies, including robotics, autonomous ground vehicles, drones, and other emerging solutions. Translate technology capabilities into commercially viable and scalable customer solutions. Build and lead a high-performing team while fostering an entrepreneurial, execution-focused culture. Represent the business with senior government, industry, technology, and commercial stakeholders. Provide strategic, financial, and operational updates to the GCEO and executive leadership.

results.title: Director of Operations - Saudi Arabia AOC (GACA)
results.description: Beond is the world's first premium leisure airline, flying an all-lie-flat Airbus fleet, and is standing up new Air Operator Certificates in Bahrain (BCAA) and Saudi Arabia (GACA). We are seeking a Director of Operations for our Saudi Arabia AOC (General Authority of Civil Aviation), based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Director of Operations is appointed by, and reports to, the Accountable Executive, and is responsible for: Exercise operational control and accountability for the conduct of flight operations under the AOC Own the operations manual, ensure ops-specifications compliance and set operational standards Oversee flight dispatch, flight-time limitations and flight-crew standards Serve as the operational interface with GACA for approvals, audits and findings Embed the SMS within operations Requirements This is a required management position under GACAR Part 121.45. The post is full-time and the successful candidate must be acceptable to GACA (the President) based on experience, competence and knowledge, with a full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)). Mandatory Hold an Airline Transport Pilot (ATP) certificate (GACAR 121.49(a)(1)) At least 3 years' supervisory/managerial experience within the last 6 years exercising operational control over Part 121-similar operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(2)) At least 3 years' experience within the past 6 years as PIC of a Part 121 aircraft — for a first-time Director of Operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(3)) Full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual; must be acceptable to GACA (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)) Desirable Airbus A320/A321 experience Existing GACA regulatory relationships and new-AOC experience Fluent English; Arabic advantageous Benefits A competitive package with relocation support where applicable, and the opportunity to build a premium airline certificate from the ground up as part of a fast-growing multi-AOC group. If you do not receive a response from us within 4 weeks of submitting your application, please consider your application to be unsuccessful due to the high volume of applications we receive.

results.title: Head of Logistics Assets (Leasing, Development, & Asset Management)

As part of its continued growth, the firm is seeking a Head of Logistics to lead its logistics warehouse platform across the Kingdom. Partner with development and engineering teams to ensure assets meet commercial and leasing requirements. Monitor market trends, rental levels, supply dynamics and customer demand to support business strategy. results.title: Manager Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary This role owns the commercial and performance engine behind talabat UAE's operations. You'll be the person who understands how the business actually ticks, where margin is made or lost, which levers move the numbers, and what trade-offs leadership is really weighing. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. You're the person who can explain why the numbers moved, not just that they did. Performance Management Own the UAE operational KPI stack, from forecast to actuals. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements. Find where the operation leaks cost or time, size the opportunity, and lead the fix, balancing efficiency against rider earnings and customer experience. Data, Modeling & Insight Be genuinely good with data, able to interrogate complex models, understand what's driving them, and pressure-test assumptions rather than take outputs at face value. Build the analyses and dashboards that make decisions faster, and translate complexity into a clear "so what." SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau are a strong plus; the non-negotiable is analytical judgment. Strategic Projects & Senior Stakeholder Leadership Lead cross-functional, high-impact projects that shape UAE operations. Build the business case, run the pilot, scale what works. Throughout, work directly with senior leadership, and hold your own with directors and VPs, defending a recommendation with evidence and staying credible under challenge. What you own vs. influence: You own the operational commercials, the performance KPI stack, and the delivery of your optimization projects. You influence the ops, commercial, and product teams whose execution moves those numbers, through insight, credibility, and stakeholder trust rather than direct authority. Qualifications What did we order? At least 4 years in operations, commercial, strategy, or consulting, ideally in a marketplace, logistics, or Q-commerce environment. Commercial instinct: you understand how a business makes money and which levers actually move it. Strong data literacy, comfortable working with complex data and models, interrogating assumptions, and drawing the right conclusion. You don't need to be handed the answer. Executive presence: able to engage, challenge, and stand your ground with senior stakeholders including directors and VPs.
